headline: Approved a General Government contract running from July 2026 through June 2029, plus updated procedural rules and a policy on officers.
summary: The meeting included presentations on the CLIMB Program, PowerSchool, and a summer employment program. Members also heard a public request about space for the Air Force Junior ROTC Program. They approved updated procedural rules, a policy, and a General Government contract.
decisions: Approved the second reading of policy BDB, School Committee Officers, 6-0.
Approved the General Government contract for 7/2026 to 6/2029, 6-0.

PUBLIC INPUT 
Danielle Biggard, representing the commander of American Legion Post 22, is interested in helping to 
reestablish or find a new space for the Air Force Junior ROTC Program. 
 
RECOGITION 
Rob Callahan recognized the LRTC Summer Employment Program. Teachers, Jason Merritt and Rodney 
Boynton were recognized and several students. 
 
SCHOOL REPORTS 
 Montello Elementary School, Next Step and Lewiston Regional Technical Center Administrators shared 
 updates with template.  
 Luke Jensen requested data on incidents on school buses across schools. 
 
CLIMB PROGRAM 
 Kirsten Crafts presented on the CLIMB Program and shared slides. Kirsten Crafts and Katie Colosante 
 recognized Nicole Desjardins and Piper Norcross. 
 
PROCEDURAL RULES 
 Assistant Superintendent Karen Paquette presented.  
VOTED: (1) Motion to approve the updated procedural rules. 
 Luke Jensen – Emily Levasseur (6-0). 7:13 PM 
 
POLICY 
Assistant Superintendent Karen Paquette presented. 
VOTED: (2) Motion to approve the 2nd read of the following policy:  
Julia Harper – Emily Levasseur. (6-0) 7:15 PM 
a. BDB – School Committee Officers 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL COMMITTEE CHAIR 
 Chairperson shared that due to staff illness we were unable to present a couple items. 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL SUPERINTENDENT 
Superintendent Jake Langlais reported that he is away at a conference. We have a scheduled list of items for 
the next several meetings of critical talking points that align with the goals. 
 
REPORT FROM CITY COUNCIL REP 
 The City Council meeting is tomorrow evening at 6 pm.  There are 2 workshops; update on wayfinding signs 
 for the downtown; and trash and recycling service. The regular meeting starts at 7:00 pm.
MINUTES – LEWISTON SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING HELD OCTOBER 5, 2026 – PAGE 4 
 
UPDATES FROM SCHOOL COMMITTEE SUBCOMMITTEES 
 Curriculum – Overview of PowerSchool for elementary, middle and high school. 
 Finance Committee – Solar contract $80,000 credit, annual audit starts next week. We did overspend but got 
 additional state funds (ML & SPED), used less of fund balance than planned (FY26). 
 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENTS 
 Help ME Grow – in partnership with 211 Maine – early childcare & education, basic needs, etc. Link families. 
 
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS 
 N/A
